title: Document a complete full-fallback example in the CLI quickstart
body: Add one reproducible unsupported-configuration example to docs/using-diffci.md. Start from docs/release-boundary.md and existing fallback regression tests. Include a minimal public/synthetic file tree, exact revision pair and command, observed fallback reason, and why full CI remains required. Acceptance: a maintainer can reproduce the documented fallback; no claimed runtime savings from selection counts.

title: Add a Maven profile command-synthesis fixture
body: Add a small synthetic reactor case in tests/repo/language-adapters.test.ts or tests/planner/test-command.test.ts for a declared Maven goal and profile. Inspect src/repo/adapters/maven.ts and src/planner/test-command.ts first. Acceptance: selected command preserves the configured lifecycle goal and profile and covers the selected module dependencies; unsupported configuration stays conservative. Avoid a large integration dependency.

title: Document adapter detection and blocker handling with one worked example
body: Extend docs/adding-an-adapter.md with a minimal worked example based on the real RepositoryAdapter interface in src/repo/adapters/types.ts. Explain detect(), contribution(), and a global blocker for missing dependency resolution. Acceptance: code matches current types, distinguishes global from file-local uncertainty, and never presents an empty graph as successful analysis.

title: Contribute a root Go-module test ownership fixture
body: Inspect src/repo/adapters/go.ts, go-test.ts and the Go cases in tests/repo/language-adapters.test.ts. Add a small root-module fixture with two packages and a transitive import. Acceptance: the changed package reaches the owning tests; unrelated-package behavior and unsupported/nested-module behavior are asserted conservatively. Run the contributor checks.

title: Add a shallow-checkout troubleshooting recipe
body: Add a recipe to docs/using-diffci.md for a missing base revision in a shallow Git clone. Show how to verify the base exists and fetch sufficient history, then run plan/check with explicit base/head. Acceptance: commands work against a public or local synthetic repository, head is checked out, and failures recommend full CI rather than implying safe selection.

title: Add an advisory GitHub Actions Core planning example
body: Add a copyable example under examples/ that builds Core and runs node dist/cli.js plan with explicit base/head on a clean target checkout. Inspect src/cli.ts and docs/using-diffci.md for the contract. Acceptance: fetches required history, preserves required test jobs, uploads the JSON plan for review, grants only needed permissions, and clearly labels the plan advisory. Validate workflow syntax and document setup.

title: Reproduce a public-repository DiffCI pilot with raw artifacts
body: Use docs/contributing-fixtures.md and the published CLI to evaluate one public repository with maintainer consent before publication. Record exact base/head, CLI version, full/selected commands, runtime distributions, cache preparation, analysis overhead, provenance and limitations. Acceptance: at least three alternating cache-prepared repetitions for a controlled claim; failed/refused runs stay in the denominator; no production-savings claims from this sandbox measurement. A fallback or negative result is useful.

title: Add a benchmark report template that retains unsuccessful attempts
body: Add docs/benchmark-report-template.md for a monthly roundup. Include attempted-repository denominator, revision pairs, completed measurements, refusals, failures, provenance invalidations, full fallbacks, net overhead and raw-artifact links. Acceptance: clearly separates static test selection from runtime evidence and modeled cost/carbon from measurements; includes limitations and next reproducible questions.

title: Clarify that the synthetic benchmark measures graph construction
body: Review scripts/benchmark.ts and the README benchmark section. Add a short worked interpretation with the actual emitted field names, three-build protocol and environment requirements. Acceptance: explains wall time/CPU/RSS fields, avoids treating graph-build timing as CI savings, and labels caller-assumption cost/energy/carbon estimates as modeled. Reproduce npm run benchmark and include the command in the PR.
